about: Roopa Screen (incorporated 2013, Ahmedabad) manufactures rotary nickel screens, the cylindrical stencils used in rotary screen-printing machines by textile printers. It also trades nickel cathodes, its key raw material. It sold to about 210 customers in FY26, mostly in Gujarat, Maharashtra, Haryana, Punjab and Tamil Nadu, from one plant at Sanand, Gujarat with 74,400 screens a year of capacity.

other.name: Nickel cathode trading share of sales

objects.purpose: Capital expenditure for a new manufacturing facility at Sanand

promoters.background: Ghanshyambhai Thakkar has over three decades and Kunal Thakker nearly two decades of experience in textile-mill spare parts, textile chemicals and rotary nickel screens. No promoter shares are pledged; promoters personally guarantee a significant part of the company's loans.

concentration.note: Top 10 customers were 34.53% of FY26 revenue (top 1: 6.43%, top 5: 21.90%). Top 3 suppliers were 90.32% of FY26 purchases (top 1: 56.35%). Gujarat was 58.93% of FY26 revenue.

litigation_note: No criminal or regulatory actions against the company. One indirect tax matter of Rs 33.38 lakh (GST DRC-01A, FY23) and one direct tax matter of Rs 0.04 lakh against a promoter/director. Company has filed 2 other cases worth Rs 14.83 lakh. Trademark/logo application is opposed.
strengths: In-house manufacturing with its own testing lab; capacity utilisation rose to 96.51% in FY26.
Revenue grew from Rs 35.71 crore to Rs 50.73 crore over FY24-FY26, with PAT rising from Rs 1.50 crore to Rs 6.48 crore.
EBITDA margin improved from 11.87% to 19.72% and RoNW was 39.60% in FY26.
Borrowings are falling relative to equity: debt/equity moved from about 1.73 to 0.45 over FY24-FY26.
Diversified base of about 210 customers; no single customer above 10% of revenue.
Experienced promoters with decades in textile machinery and rotary screens.
Planned new plant would raise capacity from 74,400 to about 163,200 screens a year and add 1,018 mm large-format screens.

risks.title: Narol unit closed; single plant dependence
risks.detail: Narol manufacturing unit stopped on 15 Dec 2025 for lack of statutory approvals, possibly exposing the company to action for past operations. Output now relies on the Sanand plant, already running at 96.51% utilisation.

risks.title: Promoter-owned premises and related-party dealings
risks.detail: Plants, registered office and godown are leased from promoters and directors. The company also has promoter loans (about Rs 2.9 crore outstanding at Mar-26 per related-party table) and Rs 73.40 lakh of sales to a promoter-controlled firm in FY26.

risks.title: Low-margin nickel cathode trading rising
risks.detail: Trading of nickel cathodes was 16.91% of FY26 revenue versus 1.29% in FY24. It is low margin and flatters revenue growth.

risks.title: Supplier concentration, no long-term contracts
risks.detail: Top 3 suppliers were 90.32% of FY26 purchases (top 1: 56.35%), with no long-term agreements. Nickel price swings hit costs.

risks.title: Expansion plan not yet contracted
risks.detail: Rs 9.90 crore of proceeds is for a new plant; civil work has begun but machinery orders are not yet placed, so cost and time overruns are possible. The project is not bank-appraised.

risks.title: Customer concentration and geographic concentration
risks.detail: Top 10 customers were 34.53% of FY26 revenue with no firm commitments. Gujarat was 58.93% of revenue, and Gujarat, Maharashtra, Haryana, Punjab and Tamil Nadu together 96.58%.

risks.title: Statutory delays and regulatory filing lapses
risks.detail: Delays in paying ESIC, GST and professional tax, plus discrepancies in RoC filings, could lead to penalties. A GST demand of Rs 33.38 lakh is contingent and the trademark is opposed.

risks.title: Personal guarantees and promoter control
risks.detail: Loans are secured by promoter personal guarantees. Promoters hold 87.40% pre-issue and will keep 63.71% post-issue, giving them control over shareholder votes.

notes: Restated standalone financials in Rs lakh converted to Rs crore; FY24-FY26 only. Price band, issue price, issue size in Rs and P/E are blank in the RHP. Fresh issue of 30,00,000 shares (incl. 2,10,000 market-maker portion), no OFS. Borrowings = long-term plus short-term (incl. current maturities), reconciled to cash flow. Reserves = reported reserves and surplus (share capital rose to Rs 8.07 crore in FY26, likely bonus). Net worth = share capital + reserves, matching reported RoNW. EBITDA, margins, RoE, RoCE as reported by company. Debt/equity and current ratio computed from balance sheet (not reported). Reservation % are of the net issue (QIB up to 50%, NII 15%, retail 35%); anchor up to 8,32,000 shares. Promoter pre-issue 87.40% includes promoter group and directors per risk factor. Total assets and balance sheet columns were garbled and reconciled by totals. FY24 RoE/RoCE as stated in the KPI table.
